what_this_is: A record of the vision passes actually run on the A3 files, in order, with what each pass reported. A vision read is evidence, never a verification: every geometric, colour, hash and retention claim is taken from scripts/cp012-cover-accept.py, scripts/cp012-motif-map.py and scripts/cp012-provenance.py, which measure the bytes.
round_2_status: The round-2 art was generated and measured, but NO vision pass on it exists. Every attempt returned HTTP 429 'model temporarily at capacity upstream' (three attempts: the three masters in one frame, the three 4:5 crops in one frame, and the motif map). Nothing in this packet is a round-2 vision claim: the motif zones were placed from a measured pigment/density map and the reviewer should verify them on audit/cp012-covers/motif-map.png rather than take a label on trust.

passes.target: audit/cp012-covers/raw/r1-montage.png (three 1024x576 round-1 raws side by side)
passes.asked: objects seen; any lettering/number/label; light direction; flat gouache on warm paper; defects
passes.reported: Japanese: lantern, noren, counter, cup with steam, two stools. Parent: jug, bowl with spoon, two oranges, plum cloth, wooden board. Technical: open book, stack of papers, brown parcel, wooden desk. No lettering in any panel; upper-left light in all three; flat gouache on warm paper; no gradient, shadow or border.
passes.verdict: round-1 raws admitted to prep; art superseded in round 2

passes.asked: one kit: paper, saturation family, line weight, light; any plate muddy or synthetic
passes.reported: Consistent warm ivory paper, muted earthy saturation family, consistent dark-brown outline weight, upper-left light in all three. The middle plate's lavender cloth is the only slightly synthetic hue and is a small accent.
passes.verdict: the phrase 'slightly synthetic hue' was the first sighting of the defect the measurement later proved: 7.08 % of that plate was plum-hued

passes.asked: what the bright green is; numbers/ticks on the jug; palette; where the form sits
passes.reported: Green is the orange stems only. The jug is blank: no graduations, numbers or ticks.

passes.target: the three round-1 masters after the 97,78,100 temper
passes.asked: is any plate too muddy, or still synthetic in hue
passes.reported: No plate muddy; muted earthy palette with the oranges now in the ochre family; the lavender cloth is the only small accent.
passes.verdict: the second sighting of the plum defect; the round-1 acceptance script widened a HUE_PLUM allowance to admit it instead of correcting it

passes.asked: does each crop keep the key motifs without an awkward cut
passes.reported: Japanese keeps the cup and the counter, cuts only frame elements. Parent keeps jug and bowl; the right orange and the cloth bleed. Technical keeps the open book; the parcel and stack bleed. All legible.
passes.verdict: RETRACTED. The Japanese crop cut the lantern to 46 of its 256 ink columns (18 %); the lantern is the world's place mark, not a frame element. The pass described its own frame and missed the subject. Round 2 replaces this with a per-motif pixel retention check.

passes.target: the leftmost 200 px of each round-1 master
passes.asked: does an object touch or get clipped by the left edge
passes.reported: Japanese: nothing touches the left edge. Parent and technical: the table plane bleeds to the left edge in the lower third, but no subject object is clipped.
passes.verdict: the left-4 % clearance rule belongs to the H-197 Press Plate lane and is not asserted for a painted plate; the round-1 acceptance docstring advertised a check for it that was never implemented, and that claim is removed in round 2

passes.error: HTTP 429, model temporarily at capacity upstream
passes.verdict: no report; not retried into a claim

passes.error: HTTP 429, model temporarily at capacity upstream
passes.verdict: no report; the 4:5 question is answered by measurement (audit/cp012-covers/motif-retention.json)

passes.error: HTTP 429, model temporarily at capacity upstream
passes.verdict: no report; the motif zones are therefore declared as measured regions and drawn for the reviewer to check

refutations.claim: Round-1 V2/V4: the contours are bold black outlines.
refutations.measurement: scripts/cp012-cover-accept.py counts near-black pixels: round-1 japanese 0.017 %, parent 0.000 %, technical 0.002 % of the frame; round 2 measures 0.000 %, 0.041 %, 0.025 %.
refutations.conclusion: The contour is warm brown #3a2318, not black. The pixel count is the record.

refutations.claim: Round-2 exploratory pass: 'each painting has a dark brown rectangular border and the paper outside each border is lighter cream than the paper inside'.
refutations.measurement: Ink share of the plate's own left and right columns (x 200-206 and x 994-1000 on the japanese plate, equivalent columns on the other two) is 0.000; the paper patch inside the plate and outside it differ by at most 3 RGB units, and the shipped corner measures exactly #f7f1e4.
refutations.conclusion: There is no painted border and no paper step. The pass hallucinated a frame; nothing was changed on its word, and the negatives already forbade a border.

refutations.claim: Round-1 V5: the Japanese 4:5 crop 'cuts only frame elements'.
refutations.measurement: The lantern's ink ran x 71-326 in round 1; the centre crop window is x 280-920, so 82 % of the lantern fell outside it and the survivor was cut at the frame edge. Round 2 measures 100 % retention for every declared motif on all three plates.
refutations.conclusion: The claim was false and is retracted; it is why the round-2 pipeline fits the whole painted ink box into the crop window.
